metadata.description: Claude plugins for the my-zodiac-ai org — universal-core engineering skills + thin stack adapters, hooks, quality/research/design, and product domain.

plugins.name: zodiac-hooks-pack
plugins.description: Reusable Claude Code hooks — sensitive-file blocking, ESLint, tsc, Prisma reminders, GSAP guard, @nuxt/content frontmatter, Serena nudges, i18n hardcoded-string warnings. Self-detecting, fail-soft, individually disable-able.

plugins.name: core-engineering
plugins.description: Universal, stack-agnostic engineering skills — caching, testing, load testing, API changelogs, docker-compose ops, Playwright, Langfuse. Works in any JS/TS repo.

plugins.name: adapter-nestjs
plugins.description: NestJS adapter — maps core-engineering onto NestJS: EDA/DDD modules, REST/DTO design, Mongoose, Redis+BullMQ caching, push, fault-tolerance.

plugins.name: adapter-vue-quasar
plugins.description: Vue 3 + Quasar + Capacitor adapter — frontend patterns, mobile builds/signing, bundle analysis, Lighthouse, deploy.

plugins.name: adapter-nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt 3/4 adapter — data fetching (useFetch/$fetch), server routes & Nitro middleware, Nitro caching, state (useState/Pinia).

plugins.name: adapter-prisma
plugins.description: Prisma adapter — schema modeling, safe zero-downtime migrations, and client query patterns (transactions, N+1 avoidance, pagination).

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Observability adapter — NewRelic dashboards/NRQL/SLO and Real User Monitoring (Core Web Vitals). Config-driven account/app IDs.

plugins.name: ai-llm
plugins.description: LLM orchestration — multi-provider fallback, semantic caching, cost optimization, streaming, tool use, prompt caching.

plugins.name: domain-astrology
plugins.description: Astrology product domain — Swiss Ephemeris (natal, transits, synastry, houses) and payment/subscription tiers. Domain-specific by design.

plugins.name: zodiac-quality-gate
plugins.description: Code quality orchestrators — SOLID/DRY/YAGNI, security, architecture, performance audits

plugins.name: zodiac-research-lab
plugins.description: Deep feature research — competitors, UX patterns, tech stack, codebase analysis

plugins.name: zodiac-design-review
plugins.description: Design review system — Cosmic Glass, accessibility, UX/UI, design system tokens

plugins.name: astrology-data-validator
plugins.description: Swiss Ephemeris validator — regression testing for ephemeris calculations

plugins.name: cowork-plugin-management
plugins.description: Create and customize plugins for your organization
